{"text":"The proposed update extends the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. On one side, a twenty-four-hour benchmark observed eighteen percent fewer origin requests, an operationally promising reduction. On the other, the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence, so the positive result and the explicit evidence boundary must remain together in the decision. I recommend approving only a canary deployment and requiring stale-read telemetry before any broader rollout. That is a bounded approval, preserving the stated result without moving beyond what was measured: the evidence supports a limited experiment, but not a broad rollout."}
